blocks.packageReason: PACKAGE, justified: the effect clears one marker string ('ballaster:1') from `summonData.erAbilityProvenance`, the per-Pokemon list of ability markers. The library has no memory block that can name and clear such a marker (requested as `effect.reset-memory`, R-B16-2 in requests/B16.md, the same request as R-B13-23). It is a single assignment, so there is nothing further to split; the trigger is a normal on-entry WHEN and there is no IF. The marker key is fixed on purpose: it is the private name that BallasterAbAttr (part 2) writes, so it is not a param. Users: Ballaster (6006, attr 0). ODDITY, not fixed: apply ignores `simulated`, so a simulated PostSummon call would clear the charge; no engine path simulates PostSummon today.

blocks.packageReason: PACKAGE, justified: the effect chooses a random Pokemon among the others on the field and then a random usable move of it, and locks exactly that move. The library has no target choice 'a random other Pokemon on the field' and no 'a random usable move of the target' choice for the tag effect, so effect.apply-tag cannot express it (requested as effect.lock-random-move, R-B16-6 in requests/B16.md). The trigger (end of turn) is its own block and the class has no IF. There are no params for a stated reason (see noParamsReason). Users: Blind Justice (6009, attr 0). The two random draws keep their order (Pokemon first, move second), covered by test/tests/elite-redux/decomp/B16/chunk1.test.ts. ODDITIES, not fixed: (1) the candidate list includes the holder's own ally (the ability text says 'other active Pokemon'); (2) `isUsable(target, false, true)` ignores restriction tags, so a move that is already disabled by another effect can be picked.

Each foe that is awake, about to switch out or protected from indirect damage is skipped, and nothing changes while the game only previews the turn
blocks.packageReason: PACKAGE, justified: the effect hurts every foe that passes a per-foe filter (asleep or comatose, not switching out, not protected from indirect damage). The effect library has no damage effect and no 'for each foe that ...' target filter, so the effect cannot be built from existing blocks (requested as effect.hurt-percent-of-max-hp with a 'only foes that are asleep' filter, R-B16-1 in requests/B16.md). The trigger (end of turn) is a separate block, the class has no IF of its own (every clause of the inherited canApply is feasibility, see the header), and the one number is a typed param. Constructor change (behaviour-neutral): damagePercent, default 25, replaces the literal /4. Users: Bad Dreams (123, attr 0) only; nothing to bind. SUSPECTED BUG, NOT FIXED: the inherited canApply refuses foes with BadDreamsImmunityAbAttr (Honk Shoo has it), but the ER apply override never tests it, so with TWO foes where one is immune and one is asleep, the immune foe is hurt as well (the vanilla apply tests it). Also the vanilla apply checks BlockNonDirectDamageAbAttr on the HOLDER by mistake (applyAbAttrs with pokemon); the ER override tests it on the foe (correct). The L2 twin cannot put a foe to sleep (the harness axis `status` sets the holder), so the sleeping-foe path is proven in test/tests/elite-redux/decomp/B16/chunk1.test.ts.
